target.statement: ShifCon improves low-resource language performance on XCOPA for XGLM564M from 52.7 (MSFT) to 55.8 (ShifCon), a +3.1 point gain.
target.table_ref: Table 2, XGLM564M row, XCOPA Low column
target.dataset: XCOPA (low-resource languages subset: Thai, Swahili, etc.)

compute.basis: Training XGLM564M with ShifCon requires 4xA100 GPUs for ~8 hours per run (3 seeds), plus data preprocessing and evaluation; on a CPU-only laptop this is infeasible.

blockers: No code or model checkpoints released
Training involves multiple stages (MSFT then ShifCon) and 3 random seeds
Evaluation requires running inference on multiple multilingual benchmarks
title: ShifCon: Enhancing Non-Dominant Language Capabilities with a Shift-based Multilingual Contrastive Framework
